title: Auto Loans: Autopay Source Account Changes
content:
An Auto Loans borrower can have the automatic monthly payment on a loan drawn from a different PCB checking account. This page sets out what such a change is meant to produce and the principles that govern how it is carried through.

## What the change produces

A change of autopay source is complete when the loan's automatic payment runs from the checking account the borrower now wants to pay from, at the APR that the discounts the loan is still entitled to will support. Any other servicing the borrower asks for on the same loan in the same conversation is settled under its own Auto Loans rule, and the change of source does not set those rules aside.

## Whose act each kind of action is

Starting and ending autopay are the borrower's own instructions about how their money moves, so the borrower gives them personally, using the actions the agent unlocks for that purpose; this is the borrower acting, not the borrower confirming something the agent has done. Bookings that the bank itself makes on the loan for the borrower are carried out by the agent.

## How each rate is fixed

Every APR written in the course of the change is rebuilt from the loan's record as that record reads at the moment the rate is written. What an earlier entry has left on the loan is therefore what a later entry reads.

## Timing

Everything involved is written to the loan within the one conversation with the borrower. Nothing waits for a payment to clear, for something to be mailed or for any other outside event.
